# GHOST DM seal vectors (Phase 9 design faza9-dm.md §6.2 - §6.7, §5.3). Generated and checked by
# client-core/dm/tests/vectors.rs::dm_seal_vectors.
#
# Layout of every blob, in all four modes
#   blob(B)  = salt(16) || hint(16) || ChaCha20-Poly1305(k, nonce = 0^12, ad, p),  |p| = B - 48
#   r_sel    = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = k_sel, salt = -, info = "ghost/v1/dm-recognition", L = 32)
#   hint     = HMAC-SHA256(r_sel, "ghost/v1/dm-hint" || salt)[0..16]
#   k        = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = k_sel, salt = salt, info = "ghost/v1/dm-seal" || namespace, L = 32)
#   ad       = "ghost/v1/dm-seal" || 02 || namespace(32) || u32_be(B) || mode(1) || pair_ad(32)
#   pair_ad  = SHA-256("ghost/v1/dm-pair-ad" || oi_sender || oi_recipient)  (pair, provisional)
#              32 zero bytes                                                (intro, bundle)
#   p        = mode(1) || body || zeros;  mode 01 pair, 02 intro, 03 bundle, 04 provisional
#   pair and provisional body = kind(1) = 01 || l1_len(4, BE) || l1
#   bundle body               = bundle_plain(1393)
#   intro body                = gen_id(4) || xwing_ct(1120) || inner
#
# The intro inner layer (the KEM half) is replayed only by the Rust differential test: the JDK 17
# provider set has no ML-KEM. Its transcript and key are recorded anyway, so an implementation
# that does have X-Wing can check every step.
#   t_in   = SHA-256("ghost/v1/dm-intro-kem" || namespace(32) || u32_be(B) || u32_be(gen_id)
#                    || q_g(1216) || xwing_ct(1120) || oi_recipient(32) || identity_pk_recipient(32))
#   k_in   = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = ss, salt = t_in, info = "ghost/v1/dm-intro-inner", L = 32)
#   ad_in  = "ghost/v1/dm-intro" || 02 || t_in
#   q      = kind(1) = 02 || sender_card(131) || binding_minute(4) || binding_sig(64)
#            || reply_seed(32) || l1_len(4, BE) || l1 || zeros,   |q| = B - 1189
#
# `blob` is written out in full for the 4 KiB cases; every case carries `blob_sha256`.
